g.title: cluster_typology
g.text: ANALYTICAL TYPOLOGY — essence / centre of gravity

g.title: cluster_axes
g.text: INDEPENDENT DIMENSIONS — do not infer one from another

g.title: cluster_solution
g.text: PROPOSED CONTAINMENT STRATEGY — PLURALISM / CLASSICAL LIBERALISM

g.title: cluster_cases
g.text: CALIBRATION AND APPLICATION QUESTIONS — examples do not prove the diagram

g.title: pluralism_context
g.text: PLURALISM: SIDE-BY-SIDE CULTURE PROGRAMS UNDER ONE LIFTED ORDER
the containing frame is itself a proposed reality-answerable Culture Strategy, not neutral absence of culture

g.title: program
g.text: executable package installed through shared culture-mechanical machinery

g.title: pluralism_context->program
g.text: contains an ecology at population level

g.title: pure
g.text: load-bearing authority cannot be defeated by accessible reality

g.title: strategy
g.text: accessible reality receives the final right of correction
may be false, harmful, or defeated and remain a strategy

g.title: tribunal
g.text: projective taboo labeling may reward repeated symbolic attack
possible sanction or violence; not every moral judgment

g.title: reality_route
g.text: causal model · trial · feedback · correction · imitation
performance is evidence, not truth or legitimacy

g.title: common
g.text: SYSTEMIC SKELETON: rules · offices · systems · incentives · feedback · succession
LIVING CULTURAL BODY: carriers · mythology · meaning · affect · formation · Beseelung
Both branches can be structurally strong and culturally alive.

g.title: culture
g.text: one mythological lens · one local bigOther · not parallel evaluators

g.title: axes
g.text: private · collective · ideological form · fundamentalist form

g.title: compound
g.text: activity fit · coordination · quality · material capability · buffers

g.title: sublimation
g.text: cathedrals · Mozart · Gregorian chant · sport · science · Moon flight
awe, costly devotion and excellence; can also serve domination

g.title: visibility
g.text: large-scale, high-fidelity reproduction → observable operative code somewhere
secrecy can shift channels but ordinarily trades off against scale or fidelity

g.title: supremacy
g.text: first-order answers claim universal civil jurisdiction
the problem is not first-order solidarity by itself

g.title: trade
g.text: superior practice may become visible and be copied
Wandel durch Handel is possible, not guaranteed

g.title: pluralism
g.text: fully installed; not neutrality, weak culture or an empty slot

g.title: heg
g.text: visible, rule-bound, survivable conflict in daylight
historical law-of-war analogy; genealogy requires verification

g.title: closure
g.text: rival loyalty, dissent, refusal, exit or succession become betrayal

g.title: shadow
g.text: governments replaceable · strategic course not voter-corrigible
bottom-up enforcement · selection · burden · conformity · refusal · exit
visible-state diagnosis ≠ occupant attribution · conspiracy · legal occupation

g.title: kommandoagent
g.text: knowing covert operational assignment at an interface
possible directed shield ≠ generic intermediary · Shadow Sovereign · required component

g.title: favour_cloud
g.text: cultivation → implicit debt → routed return favours → recruitment
locally known protocol ≠ shared map · ordinary reciprocity ≠ evidence

g.title: wmd
g.text: catastrophic · scalable · recurrent · persistent · hard to reverse
bounded analogy; not literal weapon, collective guilt or automatic ban

g.title: attribution
g.text: enemy “Nazi / WMD” label → allegation about target
nuclear taboo vocabulary cannot bootstrap classification

g.title: carrying
g.text: finance · formation · recruitment · media · logistics · appointments · protection · succession
map capability early; human carrier ≠ organizational infrastructure

g.title: schutzbalken
g.text: protected object: the concrete person as legitimate subject
contain unbounded · unanswerable · self-certifying · inescapable power
state · majority · corporation · patron · gatekeeper · cultural authority
the protector itself must remain bounded and reviewable

g.title: commitments
g.text: bounded jurisdiction · reciprocal standing · peaceful succession
public correction · renunciation of compulsory supremacy · minimum coercion

g.title: moral
g.text: courtesy · truthfulness · punctuality · due process · responsibility

g.title: adaptive
g.text: person-protecting shell · dumb public kernel · plural proposals
no score, expert, office or institution receives root access to reality

g.title: conflict_finder
g.text: surface consequential concealed conflicts for fair, preserved contest
proposal; must not become sovereign fact-checker or tribunal

g.title: freedom
g.text: formation → trust → less monitoring/coercion → more freedom/options
→ more responsibility and self-government → renewed formation

g.title: experiments
g.text: Mises co-origin → project translation: change legal priority, not borders
bounded local authority → genuine parallel experimental jurisdictions
distributed failure domains → smaller capture blast radius; not capture immunity
common rights, mobility, externality, appeal and succession shell remains

g.title: dashboard
g.text: Secure Homestead Rate under Own · separate capacities · sentinel floors · no scalar Supreme Good

g.title: sensors
g.text: scorecard: explicit but gameable · foot voting: costly but causally opaque
outcomes + testimony + audit → correction · rollback · imitation · exit

g.title: legend
g.text: Solid arrows = proposed structural or causal route · dashed arrows = possible contribution or relation · prose controls all shorthand
